preconditions.description: The number of servers n must be between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of direct connections m must be between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.
The index of the server that fails v must be between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value.splitlines()) == m and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in return_value.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The output must be either -1 or a list of m lines, each containing two server indices.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n for line in return_value.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each server index in the output must be between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(int(line.split()[0]) != int(line.split()[1]) for line in return_value.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each direct connection must link two different servers.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(line.split()[0] != line.split()[1] for line in return_value.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each direct connection must link two different servers.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or len(set(tuple(sorted(map(int, line.split()))) for line in return_value.splitlines())) == m
postconditions.description: Each pair of servers must have at most one direct connection.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(set(map(int, line.split()[0] for line in return_value.splitlines()))) == n and len(set(map(int, line.split()[1] for line in return_value.splitlines()))) == n)

return_value == '-1' or (len(set(map(int, line.split()[0] for line in return_value.splitlines() if v not in line.split()))) < n and len(set(map(int, line.split()[1] for line in return_value.splitlines() if v not in line.split()))) < n)
postconditions.description: When server v fails, the system must become disconnected.
